model_contract.full_model: versioned rectilinear barycentric centre model; coherent centre, distance and motion/RV sources; explicit TCB instants; spectroscopic RV proxy declared
model_contract.missing_rv: full model refuses missing RV; explicit angular-only approximation is a distinct opt-in model, not a silent zero RV
model_contract.distance_policy: choose and record a distance estimator explicitly; do not mix dist50 with inverse mean parallax or treat percentiles as Gaussian sigma
model_contract.centre_policy: transport a present density-mode centre with a core mean motion is an explicit approximation; not reconstruction of historical membership, morphology or density maximum
model_contract.numerical_backend: reviewed existing astrometric service; independent oracle required; no alternate chart/observer/projection pipeline
model_contract.validity: no automatic millennia coverage; provider-specific model domain and measurement/model/numerical evidence remain separate
model_contract.uncertainty: unknown centre errors/covariances/systematics stay unknown; source dispersions do not become errors of the mean
model_contract.reuse: provider certifies anchor-to-request angular separation over a finite interval within admitted coverage, with numerical error and model/resource/time identities; kernel only validates
model_contract.quick_estimate: proper motion times elapsed time is a screening estimate, not a full perspective-motion bound or absolute-accuracy certificate
model_contract.strict_accuracy: unknown measurement or physical-model bound cannot satisfy an absolute angular-accuracy request
model_contract.galactic_acceleration: unmodelled; ancient-epoch physical accuracy requires an evaluated error budget or a separate dynamical model
model_contract.scope: no SDK, source-data, default-route or rendering changes; independent object-family invalidation remains required

policy.route: Five small CDS documentation/aggregate files, one request per file; no per-star queries, retry loop or member catalogue.
policy.redistribution: Only four exact selected record pairs and audit facts retained, with source attribution and full-source hashes; no relicensing claim.
